title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage

meta.Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Let's see...
I think that's everything I needed to tell you all today... Umm...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
But I feel like I'm forgetting something.
What was it...?

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: Please remember!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Our class's homerooms are never very focused.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I've gotten used to things, and things have been pretty fun, so I don't mind.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (In terms of time, we should be done soon.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm free after this today since we don't have practice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I want to work on my singing, so I should head straight home.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Especially since we get to train with THE Morinomiya Revue next.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's going to be a golden opportunity to grow, so I need to make sure I'm ready.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm a little worried, since they're a storied troupe that runs really tough practices...)

rows.Line: (But I need to make the most of these sorts of opportunities right now.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember!
I was forgetting something.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ahem... The city will be holding a new event this year centering around its local students.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A new event...?
Can you tell us more about it?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Its official title is the “Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival”.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Put simply, it's an attempt to get all the high schools in Shibuya to put on a festival together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All the high schools in Shibuya...? They're thinking pretty big.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The details are still getting hashed out, but it should involve collaborating with students from the other schools to put on stage performances, as well as making or researching things to present at booths.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: What kinds of performances? Like dancing and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: From what I understand, the students are free to decide that for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(It sounds like it'll be pretty freewheeling.
This could be a fun festival.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Now, here's where you all need to listen.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Each school is being asked to send a few students to serve on the planning committee.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The planning committee?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes. Since the goal is to have students from different schools in Shibuya interact, they want the students to plan and run everything.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: So, if you're interested, please feel free to volunteer. I also plan on asking a few of you after this.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Anyway, that concludes today's homeroom. Get home safe, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line:
It sounds like a fun festival...
But Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival's a mouthful. What if we called it “Shibu Schools Fest”?!

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: I'm actually thinking about volunteering!

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: Then, go say that you wanna!

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line:
Huh? Actually, I dunno...
Maybe I should just participate normally instead...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (“Shibu Schools Fest”, huh? It does sound like a fun event....)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's also happening before we're supposed to start training with the Morinomiya Revue, so I might try to participate if I can fit it into my schedule.)

rows.Line: Kusanagi, do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, I can talk...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: About the planning committee I just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Would you like to be a part of it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
M-Me? Why...?
Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how good a job you did of leading everyone for the arts festival?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Which is why the other teachers and I thought that you'd be the perfect person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(The planning committee...
I am a little interested, but I still have my regular practice to think of...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Students from the other schools are going to be on it too, which means I'd be working with complete strangers.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't know if I'm ready to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: If you don't feel comfortable, then it's okay. I know this is very sudden.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: But if you're even the slightest bit interested, then I'd like you to take up this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This opportunity...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I need to make the most of these sorts of opportunities right now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just gave myself that pep talk, but now I'm acting all scared.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(This is just like the arts festival...
It could be another opportunity for me to create something with lots of different people.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes. I am a little scared...
But if it means learning more about how shows are produced, then I'd like to do it!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll let the other teachers know. Also, feel free to ask if you need any help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you, I will!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Alright...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now that I've made my commitment, I need to do my best to make this event a good one...!)

rows.Line:
H-Hi... My name is Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Nice to meet you all...!

rows.Line: Yeah, nice to meet you!

rows.Line: Come sit next to me. This seat's open.

rows.Line: Hehe. We're all in the same year, so let's keep things informal. Let's do our best together!

rows.Line: Everyone, can I have your attention?

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Chair
rows.Line: I know it's a little early, but I'd like to begin our first meeting since everyone seems to be here now.

rows.Line: My name is Shiina, and I'm the student council president at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy. My school has been asked to lead this year's event, which means I'll be serving as the chair. I look forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Chair
rows.Line: First, I'll be explaining what our work is going to involve...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This festival is basically divided into two parts. The stage performances and all the exhibits.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And the members of the planning committee each need to choose which to work on.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I'd like to help with the stage performances. Helping with them should give me some good experience...)

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Chair
rows.Line:
Alright, please make your choices now.
You'll all be talking with your groups once things have settled.

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: You're all here to help with the stage performances, yes? If so, let's start talking about what we'll be doing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: First, this joint festival involves two different stages.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line:
One is the “Club Activities Stage”.
That's where the brass bands, choruses, film clubs and such from each school will be performing and presenting.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: We'll mostly be running support for them, by preparing anything they need and organizing places to practice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line:
Then, we have the other one...
The “Planning Committee Performance Stage”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The “Planning Committee Performance Stage”...?

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: The members of the planning committee are being asked to come up with their own performance and be a part of it.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: In simple terms, it's meant to be something we can create on our own, without having to be a part of any clubs and such.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: Again, we'll mostly be supporting the clubs with their performances. But for this, we're being asked to plan and run everything ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that could be interesting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I didn't realize we'd be doing so much.)

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: Anyway, I'd like to immediately get down to nuts and bolts, but...

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: We're still in talks with the advisors for the clubs at each school, so we don't know which are going to be participating yet.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: So today, I'd like for us to start discussing what we'll be doing for our own performance.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: Any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... Are we allowed to do whatever we like for this?

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: Yes, but we won't be able to do anything that involves special equipment or skills, since we want as many people as possible to participate.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line:
Right.
Which means musical instruments are out. No bands or orchestras.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, good point...
That would exclude a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Then, what about a chorus?

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Hmm... What if one of the schools sends over a chorus? We might want to avoid doing the same thing as someone else.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Yeah, true! This is harder than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Something that lots of people can participate in while also being fun, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But everyone's good at different things...
What kind of performance would allow us to work as one and make use of our talents?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait...!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sorry, but I have an idea!

rows.Line: Not at all!

rows.Line: So far... We want to include a variety of songs from a mix of genres in order to let a lot of people participate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... In that case, why not have musicians specializing in different genres appear?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that should make it easier to include the different songs you want, and let you adjust the script to suit your actors too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, then...

rows.Speaker: Nene

Oh, that could be good...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin practicing for the show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Actually, before we do...
I should probably introduce myself again. My name is Nene Kusanagi. I'm the leader of both this show and this cast, and I'm looking forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Same here!
Hehe. This is so exciting♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm a little worried about acting... I've never done it before in my life.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's okay!
We just gotta help each other out and do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, for today's agenda...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: First, we'll go over the story, and then decide roles. After that, time permitting, we'll try to squeeze in a quick table read.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The director and actors from the troupe I'm in will be assisting me with deciding your roles. So, can you guys introduce yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi! I'm Emu Otori!
I really want this show to make everyone smile, and I look forward to working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My name is Rui Kamishiro. I'm a third-year at Kamiyama High School. It's my pleasure to be here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My name is Tsukasa Tenma, and I too am a third-year at Kamiyama High School! That's Tenma, written as “soaring pegasus”—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We don't have much time, so can we skip that part?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! But you told us to introduce ourselves!
However, I understand we must use our limited time to its best advantage...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In any case, let's all do our best to make this show a spectacular one! I look forward to working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, let's start going over the story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This story's titled “A Dream On A Melody”.
The protagonist is named Lulu, and she lives in the biggest mansion in town.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lulu is a sheltered girl, who doesn't know much about the world outside her mansion. But one day, she hears someone singing from the window, and decides to sneak out into town.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's where she meets our cast of musicians, who help her see the beauty of music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The beauty of music...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The musicians teach Lulu how to sing, and she begins sneaking into town without the butler's permission to go sing and hear the others perform.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As time goes on, she becomes friends with the other musicians, and she starts dreaming of becoming a musician who can make everyone smile.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, that's a cool development!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, things are fun for a while...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But one day, the butler catches her sneaking out of the mansion...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And Lulu is forced to return to her old, confined life.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! That's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Pretty standard development, but I'd like to hear how things unfold from here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The musicians all gather outside of her mansion and begin singing. Through their performances, they tell each other how they feel about her and this situation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They fill Lulu with so much courage that she decides to tell everyone in the mansion about her dream...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The story ends with her setting out into the world to become a musician.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to go over the story, let's start deciding roles.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Normally, roles are given out based on a individual's style and acting abilities.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, that's going to be difficult this time around. Most of you have no acting experience, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, for this show, I thought that we could try assigning you all roles which match your personalities.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Roles which match us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since that should make it much easier for all of you to follow your characters' feelings and ways of thinking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, we'll need you all to introduce yourselves, and tell us about your feelings regarding singing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our feelings regarding singing...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, because this story involves instilling joy, inspiring bravery and encouraging others to move forward through the power of singing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, knowing how you personally feel about singing should make it easier for us to assign roles to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go in order.
I'm sorry, Hoshino, but would you mind introducing yourself first?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... My name is Ichika Hoshino. I'm a second-year at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm currently the vocalist for our band...
My goal is to sing and perform in a way which allows me to reach the hearts of many different people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm also hoping that my singing will bring others together and help them forge strong bonds.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's what I want to do.
Just like my hero.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So straightforward. That answer does suit her well...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My turn next!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm An Shiraishi, and I'm a second-year at Kamiyama High School! My goal is to sing and stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The world!
That's an excellent goal!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My partner, teammates and I are gonna accomplish that by pushing each other to keep getting better!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's what it means for me to sing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe! That goal suits you so well, An!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As for me, my goal is to become a super idol who can spread hope to tons of people!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I plan on doing so by pushing myself to become a better dancer and conversationalist!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And singing obviously means a lot to me, since it's my best tool for spreading hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've certainly made your honesty and determination clear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look how much Airi's sparkling!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They all come from different genres, but they're all passionate about what they do.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They should help make this show a success.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, next... Would you mind introducing yourself?

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Yes, I'm...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I believe that's everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, Nene, would you mind finishing us off? What does it mean for you to sing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. You're a part of this cast, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
My plan was just to fill whatever role was left over. Do I really need to?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Since we're here, I kinda want to hear what your feelings are regarding singing, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. Also, don't say you're just gonna play whatever's left. You should also play the role that suits you the best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hear that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My goal is to become a world-class musical actress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I want to make as many people as I can smile through my singing.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: A world-class musical actress? That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Does that mean you wanna sing on Broadway?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... I know it's a really lofty goal, considering where I currently am as a singer...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I don't think that's lofty at all, Kusanagi.
I mean, you're such an amazing singer!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think your dream is wonderful, and it suits you really well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know it's a big dream, but my goal is to make it come true no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, let's start deciding roles based on what you've all shared.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Starting with the show's most vital role.
I'd like to begin by choosing who is going to play our protagonist...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I nominate Kusanagi to play her!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're the perfect pick, based on what you just told us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you and she do seem to sync up pretty well, in terms of having the courage to chase after such big dreams.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line:
I agree with them!
Plus, it'll be nice having a veteran leading the way, you know?

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: I also vote for you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right.
Based on what you said, Nene, I also believe you should play her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, you're also busy as a member of the planning committee, so juggling both roles won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'm going to leave it up to you. Keep in mind that we have a few other suitable candidates.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, juggling both duties isn't going to be easy. Both are big responsibilities...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. You all have faith in me, and I want to answer that trust.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And it's true, I did feel some kinship with her, with the way my friends gave me the push I needed to start really going after my dream...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I promise to do my absolute best, with all of you beside me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, Nene will be playing our protagonist.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, let's decide the other roles as well.
Starting with the first musician our heroine meets...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Considering that this is the first time on stage for many of you, you're projecting your voices incredibly well! I'd like for you all to bring the same energy next time!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, we're just about out of time.
That concludes today's practice. Thank you all for coming.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm exhausted!
Wow, acting's so hard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? I thought you did a great job of playing your character, An.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She is the musician who gets Lulu to feel passionate about music, after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You two were also perfect, Airi, Ichika!
I loved how you played the musician who inspires courage in her, and the musician who shows her how fun music is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Who would've guessed that we'd all be playing musicians? It's a big responsibility, but let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As actors and friends, we're going to give you all the support we can, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it!

rows.Line: So, we'll need you all to write these eight songs for this show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, they cover all these different genres!

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Yes, one for each musician that's going to appear in this show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
The songs should feel drastically different from one another, because each musician has their own distinct style.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's why I'd like you to come up with something with a rock feel for Hoshino, pop for Momoi and street for Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Writing songs for all these different genres won't be easy, but it should also be very rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's do our best to write songs that everyone will enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, Hoshino, are you sure about this? You're already playing a character, and you want to work on writing songs too...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Given the song count, I feel like Saki and them are going to need help. Also, if possible, I'd like to write the song I'm going to sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: I'm the leader of the songwriting team, so let me know if you ever need any help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, I will.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, let's start deciding which songs we're each going to write.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, can I go first?!
I really wanna write the song for Airi's character!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This melody popped into my head while listening to you guys talk! What do you think?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's very like you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, since she needs a street song, I'll write the one for Shiraishi.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone goes about writing songs so differently...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hoshino and Tenma prefer to use their instruments, while Aoyagi likes to work on his computer.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Some of them start from the chords, some from the melody... Everyone's style is different. I'm having fun just watching them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've finished writing a part of the chorus.
Would you mind giving it a quick listen?

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Wait, already?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, but it's still very rough.
I need someone to tell me if it goes with the character's concept.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give it a listen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna listen to it too!
Lemme hear what kind of song you came up with, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I also listened to it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course. I'd appreciate it if you all gave me your honest opinion. Anyway, I'll play it now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... You can feel how reserved the protagonist is, and how dreary it is being stuck in her mansion all day. This is incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I also thought it was really good.
I can already see the protagonist singing this song.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't know how to describe it...
But something doesn't feel quite right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something doesn't feel right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like something is missing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means my song is failing to capture some key aspect of your character.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kusanagi, would you mind telling me more about Lulu, the protagonist?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I may be able to figure out what's missing if I know what she's going to feel when she sings this song.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay. Umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like Hoshino said just now, Lulu's a very reserved and shy girl, especially due to the fact that she's been stuck in her mansion for so long.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because of that, she's developed a fascination for the world outside her window. Unfortunately, she's always been too scared to go out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Despite being constantly bored, she spends each day basically doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A fascination for the world outside...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, what if I made it sound more like this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, it's got a totally different feel to it now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...! That's incredible.
This suits her a lot more.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Her fascination for the outside world appears to be what was missing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I tried including more of her curiosity, anticipation and desire to experience new things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Toya!
It only took you a second to figure out how Lulu feels and add it to the song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...! The part you just added is such a beautiful expression of her desire to experience new things... It's crystal clear.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Then, I'll try expanding on what I have now.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright!
We can't let Toya hog all the glory! Let's write songs that send shivers down Nene's spine!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
Would you mind telling us a little more about the characters we're working on, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sure!
Let's see... Momoi's character is...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow...! This song's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree! I think it's particularly cool how the leadup to the chorus builds up and become more rhythmical!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's such a wonderful expression of the protagonist's desire for things to change.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really looking forward to hearing An and Kusanagi singing your songs, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's off practicing on her own like she usually does, so I'm sure she'll do a good job.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I heard.
I promise to put everything I have into this song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it's good.
This song is a nice expression of who you are, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think you also did a good job of capturing how the character you told me about feels.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I don't think either of us expected to run into both of you here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! What are the odds?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. We actually come to this diner fairly often.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
Also, we're sorry for bothering you both when you're trying to relax...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
We like listening to songs that others have made, and I'm really glad we could help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, then... If you don't mind me asking...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How would you two go about making improvements to this song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
I feel that it's good as it is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I suppose you could make it so the melody stands out a little more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right. It's a musical, so it's important to make the lyrics clearly audible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... Then, I'll see what I can do starting with the pre-chorus or thereabouts...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Could you two also comment on my song?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Stop.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You, on the drums... Nakanishi. You rushed ahead a bit just now. You need to stay in tempo.

rows.Speaker: Nakanishi
rows.Line: I'm sorry!

rows.Line: On the other hand, Sugawara on the sax. You're falling behind a little.

rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's try that again from the top.

rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Looks like Shiho's hard at work.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. She's playing with a slightly different type of band compared to normal, one which includes saxophones and trumpets...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
